title: State, A/B, preset, and profile tests
description:
Add juce::UnitTest coverage for StateManager A/B + gain-match, Profiles catalogs, factory preset load shape, and (where testable without a full host) delta-audition mode switching per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §14–16 and §21.8.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/StateManager.* A/B, XML schema, gain-match APIs from k.1
- Source/Profiles.* placement/tuning catalogs from k.2
- Resources/Presets/*.json from k.3
- Source/PluginProcessor.* delta audition / StateManager integration from k.4 (call only public testable APIs)
- tests/TestMain.cpp and existing tests/*Tests.cpp patterns
- CMakeLists.txt as left by k.4 (tests/StateTests.cpp should already be listed — do not edit CMake unless entry missing, and CMake is not in allowed paths)

Implement tests/StateTests.cpp:
1. A/B: capture distinct parameter snapshots into A and B; switch applies the correct slot; copyAtoB makes B match A; resetSlot restores defaults or empty without crash; serialized state restores both slots and active index after load.
2. schema_version: refuse newer unsupported versions (or migrations documented); accept current version.
3. Gain-match: prepare meter; feed known level relationship (e.g. wet quieter than dry by fixed dB via synthetic levels API or processMatchLevels) → G_match sign/magnitude moves the correct direction within tolerance; freeze stops further updates; G_match remains bounded.
4. Profiles: listPlacementProfiles count ≥7 and includes Pre-Amp / Rhythm / Lead / Bass names; listTuningProfiles includes E Standard and at least one Drop and one bass tuning; get by index stable; custom tuning setters keep finite pitches.
5. Factory presets: each of the five phase-K JSON files exists on disk under Resources/Presets/ (or via BinaryData if k.4 embedded them); parse/load path does not throw; category/name metadata present; outputGain or equivalent makeup not wildly exceed e.g. ±12 dB if present.
6. Delta audition (if processor constructible in unit tests): setDeltaAuditionMode cycles Offline modes without crash; Off is safe default. Skip heavy audio graph asserts if headless construct is incomplete — document.
7. Use juce::UnitTest; no new third-party test frameworks. Do not rewrite production code solely to force green tests.

verification_commands left empty — C++ adapter infers cmake/ctest.
acceptance_criteria: tests/StateTests.cpp exists and registers juce::UnitTest coverage for StateManager A/B, gain-match, Profiles, and factory presets
A/B tests assert capture/apply/switch/copy and XML restore of both slots with schema_version handling
Gain-match tests assert directional G_match, freeze behavior, and bounded trim
Profiles tests assert §15.1 placement coverage and §15.2 factory tunings including E Standard
Factory preset tests cover the five Resources/Presets JSON files named in phase K with category metadata
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/** production code except if strictly unreachable without a one-line friend — prefer no Source edits

allowed: filesystem or BinaryData load of factory presets
headless processor construction when already supported by test harness
forbidden: golden-file audio sample dumps as sole acceptance
network or host DAW automation requirements
